csv_project_name: A/E for Fountain Square Complex Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) is responsible for the management of the Fountain Square office complex in Franklin County. The complex consists of 10 Buildings (A J) totaling approximately 259,000 square feet, providing office space for the multiple divisions within ODNR. The facility complex has served in this manner for several decades and is now in need of renovation. This is considered to be ODNR s main campus and is located at 2045 Morse Road, Columbus, Ohio. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is being issued to obtain Professional Design & Construction Administration (A/E) services for renovation work. The buildings existing mechanical systems are aging and require replacement of key components to avoid property damaging failures and facility operation disruptions from system downtime. The intent of this project is to focus on Buildings G & H for the replacement of the VAV controls on the rooftop HVAC units, however additional units on other buildings may be addressed as funding allows. The selected team will develop site-specific plans and reconcile any existing studies for selected locations, beginning with the confirmation of facility and site assessments. These reconciliations will address the site utilization needs of varioususer groups, and utility infrastructure needs versus constraints. They will also include recommended scopes of construction projects and appropriate phasing.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
